CustomField.description: Epoch milliseconds of the first occurrence of this error signature (Hash_1). Millisecond-precision counterpart of First_Occurred_On__c, copied from the Log_Index. Compared against Created_Timestamp__c by the Is_New formula to avoid same-second false positives.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Milliseconds since epoch when this error first occurred. Millisecond-precision version of First Occurred On.
CustomField.label: First Occurred Timestamp
